# LAMMPS input script for Mg NPT relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create Mg HCP lattice
lattice hcp 3.21
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

pair_style eam/alloy

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# Set mass for Mg
mass 1 24.305

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute sum_mass all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal (c_sum_mass/(v_volume*1.0e-24)/6.022e23)*1.0e3

# NPT relaxation
velocity all create 300.0 12345
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 0.1 iso 0 0 1.0

timestep 0.001

# Output density every 1000 steps
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density

# Run NPT for 10000 steps
run 10000

# Write final structure
write_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/magnesium_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_2/relaxed_mg.data

# Print final density
print "Final_density: ${density}"
